steps.en: Resolve reuse rights and expose only the reviewed Phosphor folder to your host
steps.zh: 解决复用权利，只向宿主提供已审查的屏幕技能目录

steps.en: Give a scene brief and explicitly request prompt-only
steps.zh: 给出场景主题，明确要求只出提示词
steps.code: Use $phosphor-relay-style for a bus stop at night

steps.en: Select quality anchors and declare the frame, signal, color and focus recipe
steps.zh: 选择质量锚点，明确构图、信号、色彩与焦点配方

steps.en: Return the four-paragraph image prompt and recipe without rendering
steps.zh: 返回四段生图提示词和配方，不执行出图

value.en: A scene-specific screen-material prompt without assembling its visual rules by hand
value.zh: 得到贴合场景的屏幕材质提示词，不用手工拼装视觉规则

sources: Rights review is a reader prerequisite, not an upstream license grant; no installer is supplied.
